validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE CONFIRMED (high). Real 30-inch gas transmission (regulating/booster) line, Dizbad -> Torbat Heydariyeh, Razavi Khorasan. Inaugurated (به بهره‌برداری رسید) on Fri 23 June 2023 in a ceremony led by NIGC CEO Majid Chegeni; reported independently by mizanonline.ir and ilna.ir (both verified to contain دیزباد + تربت). Purpose: strengthen/stabilize gas supply to Torbat Heydariyeh and supply the Torbat Heydariyeh Steel Plant + Rashed (Rashed) combined-cycle power plant. The two refs the sheet actually cites are BOTH bad: iranertebat.com fails to load (ConnectTimeout) and en.irna.ir/photo/85149827 is a JS redirect stub with none of the expected tokens (does not support Status=operating or StartYear=2023). CLASSIFICATION CONFIRMED: it is a gas transmission line (a 30-in booster branch off the national 48-in trunk near Dizbad), not gathering/plant-internal. Caveat: functionally a regional feeder/booster spur (feeds a steel mill + power plant + city network and ties into the 12-in Torbat Heydariyeh–Kashmar line near Abbasabad), but 'transmission' is defensible. NOT A DUPLICATE: distinct from P6021 (Torbat Heydariyeh–Kashmar, 12-in) which it merely connects to near Abbasabad, and distinct from the P6022/P6023 Esfarayen–Neqab–Joghatai lines. DIAMETER CONFIRMED: '12, 30' matches sources (30-in main pipe-laid section + 12-in tie-in sections). START CONFIRMED: June 2023.

validity.researcher_notes: GEM Owner1 = 'National Iranian Oil Co' (100%) is WRONG for a domestic gas transmission line. The line was inaugurated by the CEO of the National Iranian Gas Company (NIGC), Majid Chegeni; ilna frames it explicitly as part of the 'Razavi Khorasan gas transmission line' network. Domestic gas transmission in Iran is NIGC (via the Iranian Gas Transmission Co.), not NIOC (oil/upstream). This mirrors a likely systematic NIOC-vs-NIGC mislabel across GEM's Iran gas rows (GulfPub also defaults many Iran gas lines to 'NIOC'). Owner [ref] cell is also currently blank. FuelSource='Dizbad' is defensible: 'Dizbad' is the tie-in point on the national 48-in trunk that feeds this branch, not a gas field.

validity.researcher_notes: LENGTH DISAGREEMENT. GEM LengthKnown=50 km, sourced to iranertebat, whose project scope reads '30-inch pipeline, 50 km' (i.e. the 30-in pipe-laying portion, Dizbad -> Robat-e-Sang). But NIGC CEO Chegeni (mizanonline/ilna) states the completed line is 'approximately 65 kilometers' end to end (the 30-in section plus 12-in sections continuing to the Abbasabad tie-in). So 50 km likely undercounts the full physical line by ~15 km. Diameter '12, 30' and start June 2023 are both corroborated and NOT a concern; only length is materially inconsistent between sources.

routes.corridor_desc: Runs roughly north->south through Razavi Khorasan. Starts at a tie-in on the national 48-in trunk near Dizbad (Dizbad-e Olya), just south of the Mashhad-Neyshabur road (~36.10N, 59.28E); a 30-in section (~50 km) runs south over flat terrain to Robat-e-Sang, then continues (12-in) through a mountainous stretch to the Torbat-e Heydarieh area (~35.29N, 59.22E), terminating near Abbasabad where it joins the 12-in Torbat Heydariyeh-Kashmar line (P6021). Straight-line Dizbad->Torbat is ~90 km while the sourced line length is ~50-65 km, so the pipe does not run the full Dizbad->Torbat distance as a straight shot - the corridor is bounded by the named tie-in points but the exact traced path (and the precise Abbasabad tie-in) is not sourced.
